paper_title: Molecular Engineering of Indoline Dyes and Their Application in Dye-Sensitized Solar Cells: Effect of Planarity and Side Chain on Interfacial Charge-Transfer Processes

knowledge_points.content: Molecular planarization of the indoline donor is achieved through cyclization between the indoline and phenyl groups, significantly reducing the dihedral angle from 55.9° in the twisted reference dye (CS-31) to 23.3° in the planarized version (CS-32).
knowledge_points.evidence: the reference dye CS-31 presented a quite large dihedral angle value of 55.9°... Through the cyclization of these two segments, the dihedral angle of CS-32 was sharply reduced to 23.3°

knowledge_points.content: Planarization of the donor segment in indoline dyes selectively upshifts the HOMO level while leaving the LUMO level largely unaffected, facilitating energy level engineering.
knowledge_points.evidence: the HOMO level was upshifted from 0.99 V of CS-31 to 0.87 V of CS-32 along with the planarization of the donor part, when their LUMO levels stayed at around -1.17 to -1.18 V.

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of longer alkyl chains (butyl and octyl) on the planar donor further reduces the dihedral angle to as low as 4.5°, enhancing π-conjugation and red-shifting the absorption maximum.
knowledge_points.evidence: along with the extension of the alkyl chains from methyl to butyl and octyl groups, the dihedral angles of CS-33 and CS-34 were further reduced to 5.5 and 4.5°, respectively... indicating a gradual improvement in the planarity

knowledge_points.content: The dye CS-33, featuring a planarized indoline donor and butyl side chains, achieved a peak power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 8.38%, with a short-circuit current (JSC) of 15.79 mA cm⁻² and an open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 755 mV.
knowledge_points.evidence: planar dye CS-33-based DSSC presented the best power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 8.38% with a JSC of 15.79 mA cm⁻²; a VOC of 755 mV; and a fill factor of 0.705

knowledge_points.content: Planarization of the donor segment improves the charge injection efficiency (ηinj) in DSSCs; for instance, ηinj increased from 74.27% for the twisted CS-31 to 86.81% for the planarized CS-32.
knowledge_points.evidence: the ηinj values for CS-31-34 were calculated to be 74.27, 86.81, 87.73, and 87.62% respectively. Therefore... the improvement of the planarity in the donor segment still obviously favored the higher ηinj values

knowledge_points.content: The open-circuit voltage (VOC) in these indoline-based DSSCs is a trade-off between the conduction band (CB) edge shift and the charge recombination rate, where the twisted dye CS-31 shows the largest CB upshift but the lowest VOC due to rapid recombination.
knowledge_points.evidence: CS-31 obviously showed the largest ΔECB among the four dyes, which was contrary to the VOC results... the relatively low VOC of the CS-31-based DSSC could only be attributed to its fast charge recombination rate

knowledge_points.content: Alkyl chains effectively suppress H-aggregation on TiO2 films, as evidenced by the reduced hypsochromic shifts of the ICT bands (15-17 nm for dyes with longer chains versus 31 nm for the dye with a methyl group).
knowledge_points.evidence: CS-31 presented the longest blue shift of 31 nm... Owing to the aggregation prevention effect of long alkyl chains, the blue shifts of CS-33 and 34 were decreased to 17 and 15 nm respectively

knowledge_points.content: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) measurements reveal that extending alkyl chains to butyl groups increases charge-transfer resistance (RCT) to 37.25 Ω, effectively suppressing charge recombination between TiO2 and the electrolyte.
knowledge_points.evidence: CS-32-34 presented large RCT values of 33.38, 37.25, and 33.63 Ω respectively... extension of alkyl chains from methyl to butyl groups could further separate the I3- species far away from the TiO2 surface

knowledge_points.content: Overlong alkyl chains (e.g., octyl in CS-34) can negatively impact DSSC performance by increasing molecular volume, which reduces dye-loading amounts and provides space for redox species to approach the TiO2 surface, accelerating recombination.
knowledge_points.evidence: the overlarge alkyl chains would increase the molecular volume, thus resulting in its lower dye-loaded amount... would supply enough space for I3- species to get close to the TiO2 surface, leading to the fast charge recombination.

knowledge_points.content: DFT calculations indicate that the vertical dipole moment (μnormal) of the dyes follows the order CS-31 (4.87 D) > CS-34 (4.33 D) > CS-33 (4.29 D) > CS-32 (4.11 D), which correlates with the observed shifts in the TiO2 conduction band.
knowledge_points.evidence: the μnormal values of all four dyes were extracted from their Gaussian calculation results, which were in the order of 4.87 > 4.33 > 4.29 > 4.11 D for CS-31, CS-34, CS-33, and CS-32
